title: encrypt.rs: dead map_err implies error recovery where none exists
description: smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs:305 — rsa_pub.encrypt() is called with UnwrapErr(SysRng) which panics on RNG failure. The .map_err(|e| SmimeError::RngFailure(...)) that follows is dead code: any RNG failure causes a panic before the error can be returned. This creates a false impression that the error is handled gracefully. The existing Panics doc section documents the panic but the dead map_err still misleads readers. Fix: replace the dead map_err with a comment explaining why no error conversion is possible here.
